summary.goal: Add REST API endpoints for build lifecycle: create, list, get status, pause/resume/cancel, and SSE event streaming. Mounted under /api/forge/builds.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /builds creates a build from BuildRequest, starts execution, returns build_id + initial status
GET /builds lists builds with optional status filter and pagination
GET /builds/:id returns full build state: status, tiers with run progress, aggregate counts
POST /builds/:id/pause pauses a running build
POST /builds/:id/resume resumes a paused build
POST /builds/:id/cancel cancels a build and all its runs
GET /builds/:id/events streams SSE events: build_started, tier_started, run_started, run_completed, run_failed, tier_completed, build_completed, build_failed
All request bodies validated with Zod schemas
Error responses use @plannr/errors pattern (404 for missing build, 409 for invalid state transitions)
Routes registered via registerBuildRoutes() following existing Forge route pattern

endpoints.POST /builds: { tiers: [{ tier: 0, plan_ids: ['a','b'] }, { tier: 1, plan_ids: ['c'] }], mode?: 'test'|'real', workspace_path?: string, concurrency_limit?: number, skip_completed?: boolean }
endpoints.GET /builds/:id: Returns { build_id, status, tiers: [{ tier, plan_ids, runs: [{ run_id, plan_id, status }] }], progress: { total_plans, completed, failed, running, pending } }

architect.pattern: Follows existing registerRunRoutes() pattern: handler factories with deps injection, Zod validation, @plannr/errors

steps.title: Define Zod request/response schemas for build endpoints
steps.description: Add build-specific request and response Zod schemas to the API layer. Reuses BuildRequestSchema from domain for POST /builds body. Adds query schemas for listing and response shapes for API consumers.

acceptance_criteria.description: CreateBuildRequestSchema: reuses BuildRequestSchema from domain (tiers, mode, workspace_path, concurrency_limit, skip_completed)
ListBuildsQuerySchema: z.object({ status: BuildStatusSchema.optional(), limit: z.coerce.number().int().positive().max(100).default(50), offset: z.coerce.number().int().nonnegative().default(0) })

BuildResponseSchema: z.object({ build_id, status, tiers: [{ tier, plan_ids, runs: [{ run_id, plan_id, status }] }], progress: { total_plans, completed, failed, running, pending, skipped }, created_at, started_at, completed_at, error })
BuildSummarySchema for list endpoint (omits per-run details): z.object({ build_id, status, mode, total_plans, progress: { completed, failed, running, pending, skipped }, created_at, updated_at })
All schemas exported with inferred TypeScript types

architecture.pattern: Same as existing schemas.ts — Zod schemas with z.coerce for query params, z.infer for types. Separate file to keep build concerns isolated.

steps.title: Implement build handler factories
steps.description: Create handler factory functions for all build endpoints: create, list, get, pause, resume, cancel. Follow the RunHandlerDeps pattern with BuildHandlerDeps interface.

acceptance_criteria.description: BuildHandlerDeps interface: { storage: ForgeStorage, coordinator: BuildCoordinator }
createBuildHandler(deps): validates body with CreateBuildRequestSchema.safeParse(), calls createBuild() factory, storage.createBuild(), coordinator.startBuild(), returns 201 with { build }
listBuildsHandler(deps): validates query with ListBuildsQuerySchema.safeParse(), calls storage.listBuilds(), returns { builds, total }
getBuildHandler(deps): calls storage.getBuild(id), enriches with build_runs per tier grouped into tiers array with run details, computes progress aggregates, returns { build } or 404
pauseBuildHandler(deps): calls coordinator.pauseBuild(id), returns { build } or 404/409
resumeBuildHandler(deps): calls coordinator.resumeBuild(id), returns { build } or 404/409
cancelBuildHandler(deps): calls coordinator.cancelBuild(id), returns { build } or 404/409
State transition errors (e.g., pause a completed build) return 409 Conflict via conflict() from @plannr/errors

architecture.pattern: Same factory pattern as handlers/runs.ts — functions return Express (req, res) => void handlers. Deps injected via closure. .safeParse() for validation with 400 error details.

steps.title: Implement build SSE event handler
steps.description: Create SSE streaming handler for build events. The coordinator emits events as it progresses through tiers and runs. Handler streams these to connected clients.

acceptance_criteria.description: BuildSSEEventTypes const: { BuildStarted, TierStarted, RunStarted, RunCompleted, RunFailed, TierCompleted, BuildCompleted, BuildFailed, BuildPaused, BuildCancelled, Heartbeat, Connected }
buildEventsSSEHandler(deps): sets SSE headers (Content-Type: text/event-stream, Cache-Control: no-cache, X-Accel-Buffering: no), flushes headers
Subscribes to BuildCoordinator event emitter for the specific build_id
Heartbeat every 30s to keep connection alive
Cleanup on req close: clear heartbeat interval, unsubscribe from coordinator events
Each event sent with incrementing event ID for Last-Event-ID reconnection support

architecture.pattern: Same SSE pattern as handlers/sse.ts — sendSSEMessageWithId(), generateEventId(), heartbeat interval, cleanup on close. BuildCoordinator needs to extend EventEmitter or expose an on()/off() API for event subscription.
architecture.events: Coordinator emits typed events: { type: BuildSSEEventType, buildId: string, data: { tier?, runId?, planId?, status?, error? } }

steps.title: Implement registerBuildRoutes() and wire into router
steps.description: Create route registration function following the registerRunRoutes() pattern. Wire into createForgeRouter() via ForgeRouterDeps.

acceptance_criteria.description: RegisterBuildRoutesOptions interface: { coordinator: BuildCoordinator }
registerBuildRoutes(router, storage, options): registers POST /builds, GET /builds, GET /builds/:id, POST /builds/:id/pause, POST /builds/:id/resume, POST /builds/:id/cancel, GET /builds/:id/events
Update existing listRunsHandler to pass plan_id and limit/offset query params to storage.listRuns() — enables GET /api/forge/runs?plan_id=X&status=completed used by Planner's ForgeClient
ForgeRouterDeps extended with coordinator?: BuildCoordinator
createForgeRouter() calls registerBuildRoutes() when deps.coordinator is provided
Route file: packages/forge-core/src/api/routes/builds.ts following existing routes/runs.ts pattern
